data.revised_prompt: Stylized concept refinement of a single original floating AI mascot named Mofei, centered full character on a pale blue-white studio background with generous padding, no text, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no scenery. The mascot has a balanced moderately rounded oval body with exact proportions close to 1.28:1 width-to-height, height visibly about 78% of width; it sits precisely between a round sphere and a flattened capsule, neither too round nor too flat. Softly domed top and gently rounded lower body. Materials: delicate blown glass with high clarity, thin refraction, subtle caustics, gentle inner glow, premium Apple-like liquid glass; clear thin cool-white and icy-blue liquid-glass shell with a deep-ocean-blue luminous inner space. Expressive dominant rounded-square deep-blue face visor occupying about 56% of body width and 48% of body height, no mouth, two large widely-spaced vertical white-blue luminous eyes. One thin blue-white orbital ribbon sweeping diagonally around the lower shell. Four large transparent glass screenshot-recognition corner brackets, one near each diagonal outer side of the body, each pointing inward toward the face and glowing cyan along its inner edge; clearly read as a screenshot crop/focus frame, not headphones or gears. No arms, no legs, no base. Clean premium concept art, elegant and minimal, crisp silhouette, subtle reflections, no milky opaque plastic, vinyl, chrome, or toy materials.
